headlines.title: Russian opposition politician Ilya Yashin cancels trip to Armenia for the final day of Russia’s State Duma elections after being warned of what he called a ‘physical threat’
Pashinyan’s salary to nearly double as Armenian civil servants set for pay rises from 2027
Moscow claims Armenia wants ‘hostile takeover’ of Russian businesses
Armenia moves to double salaries of high-ranking officials
Armenia’s anti-corruption campaign: law on confiscating illicit assets takes effect

brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
Russian opposition politician Ilya Yashin cancelled a trip to Armenia for the final day of Russia’s State Duma elections after being warned of what he called a threat. [1]
Moscow claims Armenia wants a 'hostile takeover' of Russian businesses. [3]
Armenia’s law on confiscating illicit assets takes effect as part of its anti-corruption campaign. [5]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR ARMENIA
Pashinyan’s salary will nearly double as Armenian civil servants are set for pay rises from 2027. [2]
Armenia moves to double salaries of high-ranking officials. [4]

KEY RISKS
Moscow claims Armenia wants a 'hostile takeover' of Russian businesses, indicating potential bilateral tension. [3]

WATCH ITEMS
Ilya Yashin cancelled a trip to Armenia after being warned of a threat, leaving the security situation unresolved. [1]
